vendor/sqlite3.c and vendor/sqlite3.h are the SQLite 3.51.3 amalgamation,
copied unmodified from libsqlite3-sys 0.37.0 (bundled/sqlite3/sqlite3.{c,h}).

SQLite is in the public domain. From the header of sqlite3.h:

  The author disclaims copyright to this source code.  In place of
  a legal notice, here is a blessing:

     May you do good and not evil.
     May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
     May you share freely, never taking more than you give.

Node 22 ships SQLite 3.51.2; this copy is 3.51.3 (version literal reported
by the thaw-js shim is bumped to match).
